crossRefs.note: Joab gave up the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand…
But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them; for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
But David didn’t take the number of them from twenty years old and under, because Yahweh had said he would increase…
Joab the son of Zeruiah began to take a census, but didn’t finish; and wrath came on Israel for this. The number wasn’t…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab gave up the sum of the counting of the people to the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men who drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
translations.bsb: And Joab reported to the king the total number of the troops. In Israel there were 800,000 men of valor who drew the sword, and in Judah there were 500,000.
translations.kjv: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
translations.asv: And Joab gave up the sum of the numbering of the people unto the king: and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.
